result.summary: This PR adds a new /rest/txspendingprevout REST endpoint that mirrors the gettxspendingprevout RPC, allowing callers to check whether given transaction outputs have been spent (checking the mempool and, optionally, the txospenderindex) without RPC authentication. It includes documentation updates to REST-interface.md and functional tests covering single/multiple outpoints, invalid input handling, query-parameter validation, and confirmed-spend lookups via the index.
result.problem: REST currently lacks an endpoint equivalent to the gettxspendingprevout RPC, so REST-only clients (which avoid RPC auth) cannot check output-spend status; this PR is part of a broader effort (issue #33808) to close such REST/RPC parity gaps.

result.card: This PR adds a REST endpoint (/rest/txspendingprevout) mirroring the existing gettxspendingprevout RPC, letting REST-only clients check whether given outputs are spent, checking both the mempool and the optional txospenderindex, with matching documentation and functional test coverage. It is part of a broader tracked effort (issue #33808) to give REST feature parity with RPC, but no specific external consumer is cited for this endpoint, keeping its priority modest. Review has been substantive: sedited gave a Concept ACK and raised implementation feedback (align with RPC helper pattern, cap outpoint count, exercise txospenderindex in tests) that the author fully addressed across several pushes, and maflcko's style nits were also fixed. The PR was rebased cleanly on 2026-09-01 after a ping and has no outstanding review threads, making it Ready for review with Positive agreement and no dependencies blocking it.
